_comment: Reference scores for weekly_check.py drift alarms — update when a deliberate change moves them (2026-10-20, params v1-6109fa45: per-account replay of the displayed value over FULL history — the live 35-day cache plus AccountUsageArchive, #300/#303 — with one selection floor for every model). Each window is judged by its headline error (headline_key): the median on 5h, the mean on 7d, whose median is ~1 pp for every model. The 5h median is above the 3.04 of the cache-only replay because the archive adds the older, harder cycles (3921 cases vs 1410).
